item.title: OmniTrust launches GridAuth to strengthen device identity and trust management across connected energy grids
item.description: OmniTrust launched GridAuth, a device identity and trust management platform aimed at energy utilities and grid equipment. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
item.description: Attackers exploited a critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw to deploy KeyDrift malware that steals traffic encryption keys, according to Cisco Talos. (Source: The Hacker News)

item.title: SSenStone wins 3 billion won in government R&D funding for OT security
item.description: SSenStone won 3 billion won in government R&D funding to develop OT security technology. (Source: Global Sources)

item.title: Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial systems to sabotage factories, utilities, and food production across the West, Bloomberg reports
item.description: Bloomberg reports Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial control systems to disrupt factories, utilities and food production across Western countries. (Source: Meduza)

item.title: Silent Train: uncovering Volt Typhoon's operational framework for zero-day exploitation and strategic access
item.description: Researchers describe a covert, ephemeral network built by the Volt Typhoon China-linked group after US law enforcement disruption, targeting critical infrastructure operators. (Source: Lumen Technologies)

item.title: SafePay Ransomware Breached Over 600 Critical Infrastructure Organizations, CISA Warns
item.description: CISA warns that the SafePay ransomware group has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations, raising risk of operational disruption for OT-dependent sectors. (Source: CPO Magazine)

item.title: Long-Hidden Flaws Patched in EPICS Research Facility Control Software
item.description: Four EPICS Base control software flaws, found by an autonomous system, were patched; they could let attackers crash processes at particle accelerators and fusion labs. (Source: SecurityWeek)

item.title: CISA Unveils New Strategy to Strengthen National Cyber Defense and Critical Infrastructure Security
item.description: CISA released a new national strategy aimed at strengthening cyber defense and critical infrastructure security, setting direction for operators and federal partners. (Source: CISA)

item.title: US Coast Guard releases NVIC 02-26 to guide maritime operators on cybersecurity plans, IT and OT risk assessments
item.description: The US Coast Guard issued NVIC 02-26, guidance for maritime operators on cybersecurity plans and IT/OT risk assessments, relevant to compliance planning for regulated vessels and facilities. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: MythicRatatoskr: An Yggdrasil-enabled backdoor deployed in a UAC-0099-Sandworm collaboration
item.description: Sandworm and UAC-0099 carried out a destructive wiper attack on a Ukrainian logistics company in 2025, using a new mesh network backdoor, per ESET research. Shows state actors using OT-adjacent destructive tooling against critical infrastructure supply chains. (Source: ESET WeLiveSecurity)

item.title: Cold Chain, Open Control: Exposed Refrigeration Systems Reveal Global Risk
item.description: Forescout Vedere Labs analyzes recent physical and financial disruptions at French refrigeration control systems caused without malware, and flags exposed refrigeration controls as a global risk. (Source: Forescout Vedere Labs)

item.title: SafePay ransomware compromised 600 critical organizations worldwide; urge patching and network defenses
item.description: CISA, FBI and partners warn that SafePay ransomware has compromised about 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide, urging patching and stronger network defenses. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Accenture, Dragos and SANS Institute launch $10 million initiative to strengthen cybersecurity at US utilities
item.description: Accenture, Dragos and SANS launched a $10M initiative to help under-resourced US utilities strengthen cyber defenses, with free tools, equipment, deployment help and training. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
item.description: CISA, FBI and partners issued a joint advisory on SafePay ransomware targeting multiple critical infrastructure sectors, with indicators and mitigations for defenders. (Source: CISA)
